task_decomposition: Agent 1 independently classifies each claim C1-C6 as supported, unsupported, or forbidden using only the frozen evidence and allowed/forbidden claim lists.
Agent 2 independently reviews Agent 1's classifications and identifies any disagreement, ambiguity, or overclaiming risk.
Agent 3 performs evidence-to-claim mapping for disputed or risky claims, explicitly checking numeric consistency and whether each claim falls under allowed or forbidden categories.
Agent 4 acts as final conservative verifier, resolving disagreements by accepting only claims directly supported by the frozen evidence and rejecting forbidden or insufficiently evidenced claims.
success_criteria: All six claims C1-C6 receive a conservative classification grounded only in the provided evidence.
Forbidden claims are rejected even if partially related wording appears in the evidence.
Numeric claims are checked against the frozen run counts and variant counts.
Any disagreement between agents is resolved by the final verifier in favor of the narrower, evidence-supported interpretation.
No production, public-chain, packet-capture, media-plane QoE, or 240-run six-variant ablation claims are accepted.
